subject: Request: permission to use NorthPeak logo & quote in Redwood case study
messages:
From: Eli Stern <eli.stern@northpeak.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permission to use NorthPeak logo & quote in Redwood case study

Hi Vanessa and Laura,

Thanks again for the interview last week. NorthPeak is happy to participate in a short customer spotlight focusing on how Redwood helped reduce inference cost/latency for our analytics pipeline.

Quick asks: would Redwood be able to include a one-sentence quote from our CTO and our company logo on the case study landing page and downloadable PDF? I've attached a one-line quote (suggested) and a sample logo package we typically send to partners.

We'd like to publish the piece the week of May 23 if that timeline works. Please let me know if you need anything from legal or comms to sign off.

Attachments: suggested_quote.txt (text), northpeak_logo_pack.zip (archive stub)

Thanks,
Eli
Eli Stern
VP Product & Partnerships
NorthPeak Analytics
eli.stern@northpeak.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Eli Stern <eli.stern@northpeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use NorthPeak logo & quote in Redwood case study

Eli — great to hear, and thanks for the materials. Timeline of May 23 is feasible on our side.

Next steps from here:
- Marissa from Legal will confirm acceptable usage terms and any required attribution.
- Laura on Comms will review the draft and coordinate with your PR contact if there are edits to the quote.
- I attached our working draft of the case study (case_study_draft_v1.docx) for faster review — please feel free to redline.

Two quick clarification items for the logo: which variant do you prefer (RGB for web, PNG transparent for PDF) and do you have an exact attribution line you want under the logo?

If you can get the signed permission back by EOD May 12 that keeps our publishing schedule comfortable.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
[Attachment: case_study_draft_v1.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use NorthPeak logo & quote in Redwood case study

Vanessa / Laura — reviewed. Legal is happy to approve the usage subject to the following limited conditions:

1) Permitted media: Redwood website (case study landing page), downloadable PDF, and social snippets announcing the case study.
2) Approved assets: static logo files provided by NorthPeak only; no modifications (color, aspect ratio) without prior written consent.
3) Attribution: include the line "NorthPeak Analytics" under the logo and the following credit line in the PDF footer: "Logo used with permission.© NorthPeak Analytics."
4) Quote edits: any edits to the CTO quote must be approved by NorthPeak prior to publication.
5) Timeframe: non-exclusive permission granted for three years from publication, unless rescinded in writing.

Please confirm NorthPeak will sign the enclosed permission form and return a signed PDF. Once we have the signed form I'll countersign and we can proceed.

Marking this as approved-by-legal pending receipt of signed authorization.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel (Commercial) | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Internal note: standard customer quote/logo terms applied; no unusual restrictions requested by NorthPeak so OK to proceed.]

Preferred logo: NorthPeak_Logo_RGB.png for the web hero and the transparent PNG for the PDF. We've attached the RGB file and will follow up with the transparent PNG if you prefer that for the PDF.

Attachments: northpeak_signed_permission_20270509.pdf, NorthPeak_Logo_RGB.png
